# 36Kr

> 36Kr is a leading technology news platform covering AI, robotics, venture capital, and emerging technologies across global markets with multilingual coverage.

36Kr provides comprehensive coverage of startup funding, emerging tech trends, and industry analysis with a focus on AI, robotics, autonomous vehicles, and clean energy innovation. The platform serves as a primary source for tech entrepreneurs, investors, and industry observers in China and internationally.

## Key Topics

- AI and Machine Learning
- Robotics and Humanoid Robots
- Venture Capital and Startup Funding
- Autonomous Vehicles
- Smart Home Technology
- Semiconductor Materials
- Hydrogen Energy
- Brain-Computer Interfaces
- Supply Chain Innovation
- New Energy Vehicles
- Agentic AI
- Electronics Manufacturing
- Robot Leasing
- Vehicle-Road-Cloud Systems
- Nvidia and AI Computing

## Core Platforms

- [36Kr English Homepage](https://eu.36kr.com/en): 36kr homepage: comprehensive tech news covering AI, robotics, venture capital, and emerging technologies
- [36Kr Chinese Homepage](https://eu.36kr.com/zh): 36kr Chinese homepage: tech news on AI, robotics, autonomous vehicles, and startup funding
- [36Kr German Homepage](https://eu.36kr.com/de): 36kr German homepage: tech news covering AI, robotics, autonomous vehicles, and space tech
